Astral Radiance Trainer Gallery

Released May 27, 2022 · 30 cards

StandardExpanded

Astral Radiance Trainer Gallery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on May 27, 2022. It has 30 cards. It includes 25 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Astral Radiance Trainer Gallery. Most cards: GOSSAN (3), 5ban Graphics (2), aoki (2), Jiro Sasumo (2), kirisAki (2), Mitsuhiro Arita (2), Sanosuke Sakuma (2), Souichirou Gunjima (2).
